title: LaCache: Robust Semantic Caching for LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2608.01718v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Semantic caching, reusing responses to answer semantically similar queries, has seen growing adoption in LLM serving, offering faster responses and reduced costs. Yet existing schemes are fundamentally vulnerable to cache-collision attacks, wherein an adversary pollutes the cache by injecting adversarial queries, corrupting responses to subsequent legitimate requests. We present LaCache, a simple yet principled redesign of semantic caching that provides provable defense against such attacks. The key insight is that while the adversary has full control over the adversarial query, it has far less control over the corresponding LLM-generated response, which must simultaneously satisfy multiple competing constraints. Thus, LaCache shifts the integrity check from the query to the response: rather than checking only the cache hit of a query, LaCache additionally checks the cache hit of its first $k$ speculatively decoded tokens. Analytical

translated_title: LaCache：面向大语言模型服务的鲁棒语义缓存
translated_abstract: 语义缓存通过复用已有的响应来回答语义相似的查询，在大语言模型服务中的应用日益广泛，能够提供更快的响应速度并降低成本。然而，现有方案从根本上容易受到缓存碰撞攻击的影响：攻击者通过注入对抗性查询来污染缓存，从而破坏后续合法请求的响应。我们提出了LaCache，这是对语义缓存的一种简单而有原则性的重新设计，可为此类攻击提供可证明的防御。其核心洞察在于：尽管攻击者对对抗性查询拥有完全的控制权，但对相应的大语言模型生成响应的控制能力却要弱得多，因为该响应必须同时满足多个相互竞争的约束条件。因此，LaCache将完整性检查从查询转移到响应：它不仅检查查询的缓存命中情况，还额外检查其推测解码生成的前k个token的缓存命中情况。分析
tldr: LaCache通过将完整性检查从查询转移到响应，即额外验证推测解码生成的前k个token的缓存命中，为LLM语义缓存提供了针对缓存碰撞攻击的可证明防御。
en_tdlr: LaCache provides provable defense against cache-collision attacks in LLM semantic caching by shifting integrity checks from queries to responses, verifying the cache hit of the first k speculatively decoded tokens.
